# Release record

This template records an actual repository or assembled release. Replace every placeholder from observed evidence. Use unknown with an owner/unblock action instead of inventing a value.

## Release identity and authority

- Release/repository:
- Owner role and publication authority:
- Release name/tag, if actually created:
- Source full commit SHA:
- Governance package revision, if relevant:
- Contract versions and catalog source revision:
- Runtime versions, dependency lockfile, and dependency revisions:
- Release date and reviewer roles:

## Tested components and artifacts

| Component/repository | Full commit SHA | Contract version | Environment/provider mode | Command and actual result | Artifact and digest |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | | |

- Migration set and exact revision:
- Feature flags/configuration:
- Input/fixture identities and hashes:
- Evidence URLs and hashes:
- Compatibility and consumer acknowledgments:
- Unknown cost/billing or other limitations:

## Decision and recovery

- Required acceptance IDs and owner:
- Local gate result:
- Integrated gate link/result:
- Skipped, failed, blocked, or deferred checks:
- Rollback target artifact and digest:
- Data migration/recovery procedure and tested revision:
- Publication authorization/settings evidence:
- Remaining action, owner role, and due date if actually assigned:

Do not call a release verified from a planning map, moving ref, mock result for a live requirement, missing artifact, or unrun command. integration-evals owns integrated release acceptance.
